manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find whether the AST disclosure PDF is a target form while preserving strict target-year discipline.
search_queries: 関西経理専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
関西経理専門学校 様式第2号
steps: Open the AST school public disclosure PDF under /jyouhoukokai/pdf/.
Verify the PDF body starts with 様式第２号 and the school name 関西経理専門学校.
Observe that kbc_yosiki2.pdf has no fiscal-year token in the filename.
Queue the PDF for operator review because the PDF is target-looking but not proven to be FY2026.

reusable_rules: For AST-family sites, inspect /jyouhoukokai/ and linked *_yosiki2.pdf files before broad crawling.
Use 様式第２号 plus exact school-name match as target-form evidence.
When fiscal-year evidence is absent, emit needs_operator_review with the verified direct PDF URL.
anti_patterns: Do not use corporation-level URLs from the PDF body as the school disclosure page.
Do not count a target-looking, yearless PDF as strict FY2026 success.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 verified the direct PDF body contains 関西経理専門学校 and 様式第２号, but the URL and opening text did not establish FY2026.
